the current state of the mental health system of Ukraine is characterized by the following: the system of mental health services in the country has been developed for more than 20 years, the main directions of its development are determined by the state policy of Ukraine in the field of mental health care and the development of the system of mental services; there are a number of positive trends in the development and functioning of the system, which are the result of the implementation of the national strategy in the field of health care;
the current trends in psychiatric care are characterized by a gradual reduction of the role of inpatient psychiatric care and a growth in the role of community-based psychiatric care.
the current system of psychiatric services is not optimal, and it is necessary to improve its quality and effectiveness, and also to develop a more efficient model of psychiatric care.

the development and implementation of the new model of psychiatric care, based on the principles of community psychiatry, the main components of which are the development and strengthening of primary psychiatric care in the community, the development and implementation the model of integrated mental health service delivery in the territory of a single community.

the development of the mental health services system and its improvement.

we have a very long way ahead of us in order to reach a level of mental health care system that would be acceptable in the 21st century, and that we need to work on it in a systematic way.

in the modern conditions of the Russian Federation, there is a need for a new system of psychiatric care, which should be based on community-based care and the principles of the "continuum of care" for patients with mental disorders.

the current trends in the mental health system development in Russia are characterized by an increase of the number of psychiatric beds in the community, the introduction of new forms of community-based care, the development of outpatient and inpatient care systems, as well as the development of a system of psychiatric emergency care.

in order to provide high quality mental healthcare to all citizens, we need to create and maintain a system of mental health services that includes all levels of care and all available resources, including inpatient and community care.
